retention_tricks: Dynamic Visuals: Constant cuts, zooms, text overlays, motion graphics to keep eyes engaged.
Fast Pacing: Quick transitions, no dead air, rapid information delivery to maintain momentum.
Open Loops: Hint at something coming later in the Short to build anticipation and curiosity.
Sound Design: Engaging background music, strategic sound effects for emphasis and emotion.
Text Overlay: Key points displayed on screen to reinforce audio and cater to silent viewers.
Pattern Interrupts: Unexpected visual, auditory, or narrative shifts to reset attention.
